scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @nexora/api" "npm run dev -w @nexora/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate -w @nexora/api && npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run build -w @nexora/api && npm run build -w @nexora/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run db:generate -w @nexora/api && npm run test -w @nexora/api && npm run test -w @nexora/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @nexora/shared && npm run lint -w @nexora/api && npm run lint -w @nexora/web
